Triglav.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Triglav.question: The _____ was Mountain in northwest Slovenia; highest peak of the Julian Alps.
Triglav.fact: Triglav (pronounced [ˈtɾíːɡlaw]; German: Terglau; Italian: Tricorno), with an elevation of 2,863.65 metres (9,395 ft 2+1⁄8 in), is the highest mountain in Slovenia and the highest peak of the Julian Alps. It is the centrepiece of Triglav National Park, Slovenia's only national park.

Tripartite Pact.fact: The Tripartite Pact, also called the Berlin Pact, was an agreement between Germany, Italy, and Japan signed in Berlin on 27 September 1940 by, respectively, Joachim von Ribbentrop, Galeazzo Ciano, and Saburō Kurusu (in that order) and in the presence of Adolf Hitler.
